# omada_site_snmp (Resource)

Which SNMP versions the devices of an existing Omada site answer. Creating this resource takes over the site's SNMP setting, and removing it only stops Terraform management. The community string and the SNMPv3 credentials are not managed: switching a version on needs them to be set in the controller first, and switching it off keeps them there.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Switches SNMP off for the provider's site. The community string and the
# SNMPv3 credentials stay in the controller and are not managed.
resource "omada_site_snmp" "this" {
  v1v2c_enabled = false
  v3_enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.
- `v1v2c_enabled` (Boolean) SNMP v1 and v2c.
- `v3_enabled` (Boolean) SNMPv3.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by the site ID or the site name, like omada_site.
terraform import omada_site_snmp.this Default
```
